```artifact
Feature: Alarms in GUI

  Scenario: GUI computes a "HIGH VTE" alarm
    Given the VTE for the current breath is 15
    And the threshold for HIGH VTE alarm is 10
    When the GUI computes the VTE
    Then a "HIGH VTE" alarm should be triggered

  Scenario: GUI computes a "LOW VTE" alarm
    Given the VTE for the current breath is 5
    And the threshold for LOW VTE alarm is 10
    When the GUI computes the VTE
    Then a "LOW VTE" alarm should be triggered

  Scenario: GUI computes VTE for each breath
    Given the VTE for the current breath is 10
    When the GUI computes the VTE
    Then the VTE value should be 10

  Scenario: GUI handles cancelled "pressure high" alarm
    Given the "pressure high" alarm is active
    When the alarm is cancelled
    Then the "pressure high" alarm should not re-trigger for 2 minutes

  Scenario: GUI computes high-priority alarm for O2 input line disconnection
    Given the O2 input line is disconnected
    When the GUI checks the O2 input line
    Then a high-priority alarm should be triggered

  Scenario: GUI displays all currently active alarms
    Given there are multiple active alarms
    When the GUI displays the alarms
    Then all active alarms should be shown

  Scenario: Event log includes all confirmed alarm settings
    Given an alarm is confirmed
    When the event log is checked
    Then the confirmed alarm settings should be included in the event log
```
